meaning: How a dataset of the kaggle_public_good line gets its proposed SDG goals and targets. Each rule names phrases and the evidence fields it reads: name (the dataset's slug and title), files (file names), columns (column names of every profiled table), values (the values of columns with at most 24 distinct values) and documentation (the dataset's own README and data card). Text is lower-cased, camelCase and separators become spaces, and a phrase matches only as whole words; a rule's stems match inside a word, for column names written as one word. A rule whose unless phrase also appears in its fields does not apply. Every rule that applies adds its goals, targets and indicators with the phrase and field that matched it; a dataset no rule matches has no goal rather than a stretched one. Goals and targets follow the SDG global indicator framework (A/RES/71/313 and its annual refinements) and every target is checked against tools/query_multiplier/data/sdg-vocabulary-v1.json. The result is a proposal that reviewers read when they attach PublicGoodGrant goals after independent approval; nothing is granted here.

review.population: the first 30 dataset folders of the October 6, 2026 backup in name order
review.record: a private review record beside the run (kaggle-sdg-review.json); the builder's --sdg-review reports how many proposals equal the reviewed answer
review.result: two of 30 reviewed answers differed from rule output before the changes below; the builder's --sdg-review run reports the agreement after them

changes.change: Word breaks after an acronym (TotalGHGEmissions reads total ghg emissions) and rule stems that match inside a word (ghg, co2e for the greenhouse gas rule; k btu and site energy use for the building energy rule).
changes.reason: The hand review found two building energy benchmarking tables whose greenhouse gas columns are single words (TOTGHGEMISSIONS_METRICTONSCO2E, TotalGHGEmissions), which whole-word phrases missed; both tables record emissions per building, so goal 13 belongs in their proposal.

changes.change: The road traffic rule reads collisions and road traffic besides collision.
changes.reason: A plural in a dataset's name did not match the singular phrase.

changes.change: The trafficking rule also reads the values of columns with few distinct values, and names document confiscation.
changes.reason: A training corpus labels its prompts labor_trafficking and coercion_document_confiscation while its documentation never names trafficking.

changes.change: A weather rule of its own that reads only names and file names; the alcohol, service request and crime rules gain unless phrases; public lands and urban trees are two rules; the enterprise rule no longer reads companies list.
changes.reason: Reading the proposals of all 243 datasets after the reviewed 30 found weather-condition columns of road crash tables proposing goal 13, liquor-law arrests proposing 3.5, configuration files named for 311 proposing 11 and 16, a traffic collision table recorded under crime codes proposing 16.1, federal lands proposing 11.7, and a list of technology start-ups proposing 8.3.

rules.reason: Area deprivation and poverty measures: target 1.2 (reduce poverty in all its dimensions, indicator 1.2.2) and target 10.2 (social and economic inclusion, indicator 10.2.1).

Disaster risk, flood exposure and economic losses: targets 1.5 (resilience of the poor, indicator 1.5.2 economic loss), 11.5 (indicator 11.5.2 direct economic loss) and 13.1 (resilience to climate-related hazards).
Climate-related hazard events (storms, landslides): indicators 1.5.1, 11.5.1 and 13.1.1 count the people dead, missing or affected by disasters.

Geophysical hazards and building exposure to them: targets 1.5 and 11.5 (deaths, missing and losses from disasters, indicators 1.5.1 and 11.5.1) and 11.b (disaster risk reduction in cities). Earthquakes are not climate-related, so goal 13 is not proposed.
Crop and livestock production: target 2.3 (agricultural productivity) and target 2.4 (sustainable food production systems, indicator 2.4.1).
Where safe food can be bought and whether food premises pass inspection: target 2.1 (access by all people to safe, nutritious and sufficient food).
Drug overdose deaths: target 3.5 (prevention and treatment of substance abuse, including narcotic drug abuse).
Alcohol sales volumes: target 3.5 includes harmful use of alcohol, and indicator 3.5.2 is alcohol consumption per capita.
Road traffic crashes and transit safety: target 3.6 (road traffic deaths and injuries, indicator 3.6.1) and target 11.2 (safe transport systems).
Ambient air pollution: indicator 11.6.2 (annual mean fine particulate matter in cities) and target 3.9 (deaths and illness from air pollution, indicator 3.9.1).
Cardiovascular and diet-related disease risk and reported well-being: target 3.4 (reduce premature mortality from non-communicable diseases and promote mental health and well-being, indicator 3.4.1).

Hazardous chemicals in products and environmental compliance of facilities: target 3.9 (illness from hazardous chemicals and pollution) and target 12.4 (sound management of chemicals and wastes, reducing releases to air, water and soil).
Domestic, family and sexual violence: target 5.2 (eliminate violence against women and girls) and target 16.1 (reduce all forms of violence).

Human trafficking, forced labour and debt bondage: target 8.7 (end forced labour, modern slavery and human trafficking), 16.2 (end trafficking, indicator 16.2.2 victims of trafficking) and 5.2 (which names trafficking of women and girls).

Recruitment and deployment of migrant workers: target 8.8 (labour rights of migrant workers) and target 10.7 (orderly, safe and responsible migration; indicator 10.7.1 is the recruitment cost a worker bears).
Deaths and disappearances during migration: indicator 10.7.3 (people who died or disappeared in the process of migration towards an international destination).
Earnings of employees, with the sex of each employee where the table records it: target 8.5 (equal pay for work of equal value, indicator 8.5.1 average hourly earnings by sex).
Positions in public institutions: indicator 16.7.1 (proportions of positions in public institutions compared with national distributions).
Registers of businesses and their licences: target 8.3 (formalization and growth of micro, small and medium-sized enterprises).

Registers of lenders, banks, money service operators and trust or company service providers: target 8.10 (access to financial services), 10.5 (regulation and monitoring of financial institutions) and 16.4 (illicit financial flows, which these registers help supervise).

Energy use intensity and efficiency of buildings and vehicles, and the climate zones building energy codes use: target 7.3 (double the improvement in energy efficiency, indicator 7.3.1 energy intensity).
Electricity providers and the rates households and businesses pay: target 7.1 (universal access to affordable, reliable energy services).
Generation capacity, the energy mix and alternative fuels: target 7.2 (increase the share of renewable energy, indicator 7.2.1).
Greenhouse gas emissions: target 13.2 (climate measures in policy and planning, indicator 13.2.2 total greenhouse gas emissions per year).
Temperature and precipitation records for monitoring climate and planning adaptation: target 13.1 (resilience to climate-related hazards) and target 13.3 (capacity on adaptation and early warning).

A dataset named for its weather observations: target 13.1 (resilience to climate-related hazards) and target 13.3 (adaptation and early warning). A weather column of another table (the conditions at a road crash) is not one.
Groundwater stations and water rights: target 6.4 (water-use efficiency and water stress, indicator 6.4.2) and target 6.5 (integrated water resources management).
Lakes and inland water bodies: target 6.6 (protect water-related ecosystems, indicator 6.6.1) and target 15.1 (inland freshwater ecosystems).
Coastlines and marine areas: target 14.2 (sustainably manage and protect marine and coastal ecosystems).
Public lands, forests and protected areas: target 15.1 (conservation of terrestrial and inland freshwater ecosystems).
Street trees and green space in cities: target 11.7 (universal access to green and public spaces).

Requests residents make to city agencies (waste, streets, noise, buildings) and how agencies resolve them: target 11.6 (municipal waste and the urban environment) and target 16.6 (effective, accountable institutions; indicator 16.6.2 is satisfaction with public services, which resolution data informs but does not measure).
Transport options and how people travel: target 11.2 (safe, affordable, accessible and sustainable transport, indicator 11.2.1 access to public transport).
Passenger and freight movements and port infrastructure: target 9.1 (quality, reliable and resilient infrastructure, indicator 9.1.2 passenger and freight volumes by mode of transport).
Mobile network infrastructure: target 9.c (access to information and communications technology, indicator 9.c.1 population covered by a mobile network).
Housing supply, property values and vacant or unsafe buildings: target 11.1 (access to adequate, safe and affordable housing, indicator 11.1.1).

Permits, inspections, building footprints and population density in cities: target 11.3 (inclusive and sustainable urbanization and planning, indicator 11.3.1 land consumption against population growth).
Cultural heritage (museum collections, endangered languages): target 11.4 (protect and safeguard the world's cultural and natural heritage).
Recorded crime, arrests, shootings and police calls: target 16.1 (reduce all forms of violence and related death rates, indicators 16.1.1 and 16.1.3) and target 16.3 (rule of law).
Political violence and conflict events: target 16.1 (indicator 16.1.2 conflict-related deaths per 100,000 population).
Complaints against police and court decisions: target 16.3 (rule of law and equal access to justice) and target 16.6 (effective, accountable and transparent institutions).

Election results by candidate: target 16.7 (responsive, inclusive and participatory decision-making) and, where candidates' sex is recorded, indicator 5.5.1 (seats held by women in national parliaments).
Government payments, contracts and spending: target 16.6 (effective, accountable and transparent institutions, indicator 16.6.1 government expenditure against the approved budget).
Use of a government open data portal: target 16.10 (public access to information).
Who takes part in a public programme compared with the census population: target 10.2 (social, economic and political inclusion of all).
Gross domestic product: target 8.1 (sustain per capita economic growth, indicator 8.1.1).
Financial and banking crises: target 17.13 (global macroeconomic stability).
Tariff schedules: target 17.10 (a rules-based multilateral trading system, indicator 17.10.1 weighted tariff average) and target 17.12 (duty-free, quota-free market access).
